title: Emergency declared under caretaker framework
detail: Political confrontation and election deadlock culminated in emergency rule and a reconfigured caretaker administration.

title: Political detentions and anti-corruption drives expand
detail: Major political leaders and activists faced detention while the interim regime pursued large-scale legal and administrative interventions.

title: General election restores elected government
detail: Parliamentary elections ended the emergency-era caretaker phase and reopened regular party-based governance.
